description: Two echoes in 2HP with feedback, differing in their delay range: ECHO1 runs from 0.05ms to 2000ms and ECHO2 from 0.01ms to 200ms

params.text: Sets the delay time of ECHO1, from 0.05ms to 2000ms
Sets the delay time of ECHO2, from 0.01ms to 200ms
Sets how much of the delayed signal is summed back into the front of the echo

inputs.text: A voltage added to the time set by TIME; an oscillator or LFO patched here modulates the delay
Pulses here set the delay time from the interval between them, overriding both TIME and CV
